description: A .NET 8 microservice solution template for high-load systems, proven in production. Layered services on PostgreSQL; RabbitMQ with a transactional outbox, Hangfire jobs, ClickHouse, object storage, a YARP gateway, deployment files and CI are one flag away, wired and tested.
releaseNotes:
SQL Server, HashiCorp Vault and a stronger API gateway.

- Generate a solution on SQL Server with --Database mssql.
- Read secrets from HashiCorp Vault with --Vault.
- Improved the API gateway and its Swagger documents.
- Settings read on each use change without a redeploy.
- Simplified feature flags.
- Secrets live only in their store and in memory.

How to update a solution generated from an earlier version: https://github.com/sawking-tech/DotNetSolutionKit/blob/v2.7.0/docs/getting-started/upgrading.md
title: DotNet Solution Kit
